item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows four events Krish studies: P, a bat hits a cricket ball; Q, a pebble sits still on a path; R, Krish pulls a school bag; S, a feather drifts down.

Which claims correctly treat a force as a push or pull between two objects? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: Event P names a force: a push between the bat and the cricket ball.
options.B: Event Q names a force: the resting pebble applies a force to itself.
options.C: Event R names a force: a pull between Krish's hand and the school bag.
options.D: Event R names a force: the pull acts only on the school bag.
